sentences.text: Stinging nettle is pollinated by wind.
In Mainz-Bingen it has been reported 259 times over ten years, mainly from April to July, peaking in May.
The peacock and the small tortoiseshell are recorded as predators, with 3 and 2 GloBI records respectively.
It is recorded as a host of the peacock, the map and the small tortoiseshell.
